name: Relay
tagline: Amp and cab switching for studios — architecture and safety requirements, not yet a verified design.
description:
Relay is the studio direction: recalling which pre-amp, power amp and cabinet are connected, from your desk, over MIDI.

It is at the architecture stage. Switching power amps and speaker cabinets involves impedance, power, load and switching conditions that must come from a verified design. Until then we make no claims about universal amp/cab compatibility or pop-free operation, and the Relay mode in the editor is a placeholder. Never treat an unverified relay design as safe for power-amp or speaker switching.
